summary: Phase 3 of ASM↔Solution Finder unification tested (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass — ACM 2026-06-02-05 seeded, Org/Govt/Nature feature access is 'full' for free user, /api/solution-matrices CRUD works with title-only save (no area_of_life required), and POST /api/solution-matrices/{entry_id}/push-action-plan correctly fans out into action_items + ctt_tasks + lifestyle_routines per push_ctt / push_lifestyle flags with correct counts. 404 path verified. Frontend (/tools/solution-matrix at 390x844): step indicator shows EXACTLY 3 steps in the required order — (1) Solution Matrix, (2) Categories & Sources, (3) Action Plan — and none of the old four tabs are present. Tab 1 shows a 'Title' label + TextInput at the top above the matrix grid. Standard (15-cell) ⇄ Accurate (60-cell) mode toggle is present; in 60-cell mode the Individual/Org/Govt/Nature org-type pills render with zero lock-closed icons (unlocked, as required). Tab 3 displays the 'Save first' tip when the entry is unsaved and the 'No matrix entries yet' empty state, with Push button hidden until cells exist. No React Native red-screen or page errors. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (logged in console: 'Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use expo-audio and expo-video').

issues: Bottom-right floating font-size widget (A / A+ / A++) overlaps the green 'Save' CTA on small viewports (390x844) — visually adjacent and on tap-target collision range. Consider moving the widget or padding the footer to keep 44px minimum tap separation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package expo-av is still bundled. Console warns: 'Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages to replace the required functionality.' Reference: detected at runtime in expo web console; migrate audio→expo-audio and video→expo-video.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add testID attributes on ASM step pills, Title input, Save button, Action Plan checkboxes, CTT/Lifestyle toggle pills, Select all and 'Push selected to Action Center' button — currently only matrix-templates-icon and matrix-download-icon have testID. This will make Playwright/UI regression cheaper.
Migrate off expo-av to expo-audio + expo-video (SDK 54 readiness).
Reposition the floating A / A+ / A++ font-size adjuster so it doesn't collide with the Save CTA at the bottom-right on mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/tools.py line 404: local annotation 'counts: Dict[str, int]' — Dict is not imported in that file; runtime-safe (annotation only, evaluated lazily under PEP 563 default behavior in 3.10+), but lint will warn. Either add 'from typing import Dict' or change to 'dict[str, int]'. (Pre-flagged by main agent; left as-is.)

/app/backend/routes/tools.py POST /solution-matrices/{entry_id}/push-action-plan does not validate body shape with Pydantic — silently ignores malformed items. Acceptable for now since the frontend constructs the payload, but consider a Pydantic model for forward compat.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all Phase-3 acceptance criteria visible; one minor footer overlap)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_phase3_* solution_matrices entries via fixture teardown. Push test inserted 3 action_items + 2 ctt_tasks + 2 lifestyle_routines under the test user's entry; left in place for the user since they are scoped to the test entry which was deleted afterward where applicable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 (3-tab ASM with title-only save + push-action-plan) is fully verified end-to-end. The /api/acm/my-access endpoint is the correct way to assert feature unlocking (not the non-existent /api/acm/feature-access/{id}). ASM page only has 2 testIDs (matrix-templates-icon, matrix-download-icon); rely on text-based selectors for the step pills and Save/Next buttons in the meantime. The Save CTA is on Step 3 only — Step 1 shows 'Next', Step 2 shows 'Back / Next', Step 3 shows 'Back / Save'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional defects found. The two minor items are: (a) UX collision between the floating A/A+/A++ widget and the Save button on small viewports; (b) expo-av deprecation warning.
